name: Fundviser Capital (India) Limited
about: Fundviser Capital (India) Limited operates as an investment company in India. The company operates in five segments: Investment Activities & Derivatives, Bullion, Media & Entertainment, Merchant & Foreign Trading, and Real Estate. It offers investment management, financial structuring, cyclical reinvestment, and stakeholder returns services. The company is involved in the operation of theatres; real estate development business; provision of import, export, sourcing, and distribution services; and offers Disha V600, a vehicle tracking and safety system with GPS, SOS alerts, and SMS fallback for low-network areas. The company was formerly known as Bagadia Colourchem Limited and changed its name to Fundviser Capital (India) Limited in October 2018. Fundviser Capital (India) Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.
